title: Integration surge owner rollup — telemetry endpoints (Mar 2026)
content:
Purpose:
A lightweight, ad-hoc sheet for capturing owner coverage, fallback contacts and minimal impact estimates for the telemetry ingestion endpoints we expect to see a short-term surge on. Use during the testing window and first 72 hours of rollout. Primary use: quick lookup during paged incidents or when we need to re-route traffic to fallback collectors.

How to use this sheet (quick):
- Owners/backup: person responsible for first response and who to escalate to. If owner is unavailable, call backup.
- On-call window: hours (UTC) where owner is expected to be reachable for the rollout period.
- Risk score: quick 1-5 estimate (1 low, 5 high) of customer-visible impact if integration drops.
- Triage steps: 3-line play to restore or route around. Keep minimal.
- Access & dependencies: which teams/systems hold keys, KMS, DNS, ingress rules.

Columns (spreadsheet view):
- Integration ID
- Integration name
- Primary owner
- Backup owner
- Team (dept owning integration)
- Region(s) impacted
- On-call window (UTC)
- Expected surge window (local dates)
- Risk score (1-5)
- Access needed for quick fix
- Known fallback (route/collector id)
- Triage summary (2-3 bullet lines)
- Last smoke test result (pass/fail)
- Notes / open blockers
- Next check-in (date/time)

Sample rows (copy into tracker):
1) INT-telemetry-01 | ingestion-api-v2 | Liam O'Connor | Aisha Patel | infra-telemetry | us-west-2, eu-west-1 | 08:00-20:00 UTC | 2026-03-20 — 2026-03-22 | 4 | deploy-runner, KMS-admin, DNS-edit | fallback-collector-3 | Check ingress logs -> rotate certs -> switch route to fallback | pass (2026-03-14) | SSL cert renewal pending, redeploy scheduled 3/19 | 2026-03-19 09:00 UTC

2) INT-telemetry-lite | SDK-batcher | Diego Martinez | Priya Rao | platform-ingest | global | 00:00-23:59 UTC | 2026-03-21 — 2026-03-23 | 3 | SDK key rotation access, infra-console | fallback-lite-01 | Scale batch workers -> throttle clients -> flip to lower-qps path | fail (2026-03-10) | SDK rollout paused, dep on SDK v1.8.2 fix | 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC

3) INT-metrics-proxy | metrics-proxy | Aisha Patel | Miguel Santos | observability | us-east-1 | 12:00-00:00 UTC | 2026-03-22 — 2026-03-24 | 2 | proxy-admin, LB-edit | metrics-collector-standby | Restart proxy -> clear KV-cache -> warm collector | pass (2026-03-12) | LB healthcheck threshold flaky | 2026-03-22 12:30 UTC

Open questions / quick actions (owner: Maya):
- Confirm fallback collector capacity: infra-telemetry to validate baseline and headroom (Liam).
- Ensure KMS rotation window does not overlap surge window; if it does, postpone rotation (Security).
- Short smoke script to run pre-cutover (automated; run by Diego).

Suggested quick escalation matrix (phone/SMS):
- P1 incident (service down or >50% error rate): page primary owner -> if no acknowledge in 10m, page backup and infra-SRE -> open incident bridge and post to #prod-ops.
- P2 (degraded latency or partial errors): page primary owner -> 30m SLA to respond, backup on 60m.

Notes / heuristics for triage summaries (keep terse):
- Always include immediate mitigation (route to fallback / rate-limit issuer).
- One-line root cause hypothesis (eg: cert expiry, throttling, misrouted DNS).
- One-line next action owner and ETA.

Appendix (links useful for quick checks):
- Quick dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/telemetry-surge
- Fallback collectors inventory: confluence:telemetry/fallback-collectors
